resources.string: Control your phone with air hand gestures

AirX1 lets you control this phone with hand gestures seen by the front camera. When enabled, it draws a cursor on screen and performs taps, long presses, drags, scrolls and navigation actions (Back, Home, Recents) on your behalf, but only while you have armed it with a gesture. It reads the positions of buttons on screen so the cursor can snap onto them, notices when a keyboard opens to make the cursor more precise, and can type into the focused text field with its own on-screen keyboard (AirKeys). Screen content is used only on this device, in memory, and is never stored or sent. All camera processing happens on this device: AirX1 has no internet permission and never saves or sends camera images.
AirX1 is watching for your hand
Camera is processed on-device only. Tap Stop to turn off.
